mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS over at least 3 consecutive months signals a prolonged easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS stops declining within the 20-day horizon, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting stronger labor market conditions and increased corporate optimism.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 4.5% within the 20-day horizon, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly UNRATE below 4.5% and quarterly GDPC1 exceeding 16,000 (Chained 2017 Dollars) triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting robust labor market strength and economic expansion.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 16,000 or UNRATE remains ≥4.5% in the prior month within the 5-day horizon, or 5-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly INDPRO exceeding 107.0793 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting near-capacity utilization and momentum.
candidate_trigger: IN D late-cycle expansion regime: INDPRO > 107.0793
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 107.0793 in the late-cycle regime within the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1's upward trend reverses within the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO exceeding 110.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting robust manufacturing momentum and sectoral strength.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 110.0 in the prior month within the 5-day horizon, or 5-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 0.15% and concurrent fall in UNRATE below 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to conflicting policy and labor market signals.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 0.15 or UNRATE remains ≥4.5% in the prior month within the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly negative than baseline (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a tightening cycle regime, a monthly FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.18% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as aggressive rate hikes pressure equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: IN D tightening cycle regime: FEDFUNDS > 0.18%
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 0.18% in the tightening regime within the 5-day horizon, or 5-day returns are not significantly negative than baseline (p < 0.05).
